description: Look up one or more usernames across 400+ sites and return verified profiles with per-site status.

categories.description: Only check sites in these categories. Combined with `sites` as a union. Leave empty for all categories.
categories.title: Categories

enrichProfiles.description: Add display name, bio, avatar, follower counts, join date, location, website and verified flag where the site exposes them.
enrichProfiles.title: Extract profile fields

includeAvailable.description: Also emit rows for sites where the handle is free, blocked, unknown or illegal. Useful for availability checks.
includeAvailable.title: Include available/blocked rows

includeNsfw.description: Also check adult sites. Off by default.
includeNsfw.title: Include NSFW sites

maxSitesPerUsername.description: Check only the top N priority sites per handle. 0 checks every selected site (0–500).
maxSitesPerUsername.title: Max sites per username

maxUsernames.description: Cap the number of handles after wildcard expansion (1–100).
maxUsernames.title: Max usernames

enumTitles: One row per username (legacy links + profiles)
outputMode.title: Output mode

sites.description: Only check these sites. Accepts names (GitHub), domains (github.com) or profile URLs. Leave empty for every supported site.
sites.title: Sites

username.description: Optional single handle merged into `usernames`. The `usernames` array is still required.
username.title: Single username

usernames.description: Handles to look up. A leading @ is ignored. Use {?} to expand to _, - and . (e.g. john{?}doe).
usernames.title: Usernames

verifyClaims.description: Re-check every generic claimed site with a random decoy handle. Sites that claim any handle are demoted to unverified and kept out of `links`.
verifyClaims.title: Verify claimed profiles

title: Sherlock Username Search
